# The 2026-08-25 15:00 earthquake

What the ExpTech API answered for report `115057-2026-0825-150011` (M5.9, east of Taitung),
from 5 s before its origin to 180 s after: each archive's frames by the second (rts.v1,
EEW, intensity.v1), the station list, the report list and the report itself. Keyed by
URL, JSON minified, gzip. The app's tests replay it in virtual time.
